title: Encoder · MTF-JEPA-MAE-VICReg
purpose: Discover and develop reusable MTF-JEPA-MAE-VICReg architecture components and encoder tools that operations and application projects can configure, train and compose.
boundary: Own the family definition, supported configuration, portable initialization/preprocessing/training/export/resume surfaces and their scoped evidence, with unimplemented coverage stated explicitly. Cuwacunu and other applications own substantial application training and final docking. Keep architecture, configuration, recipe and trained instance separate; checkpoint scores do not restrict a family to one benchmark shape. Follow the shared encoder component instructions and preserve frozen source and research records. The shared component delivery contract governs reusable learning semantics, application recipe choices, raw versus trusted artifacts and release acceptance. A complete training method and source closure travel with the family.
summary: Portable MTF training/source delivery is complete for its scoped CPU/F32 surface: configurable construction, explicit identity preparation, two seeded recipes, typed training/inference state and a verified 57-file source bundle. Two configurations/two samplers passed primary and isolated engineering checks. Retained MTF-v1 identities and historical unknown associations remain intact; provider/toolset integration is still proposed, with no encoder-quality or application-utility claim.

milestones.description: Passed bounded artificial engineering checks for C2/H16/F3/latent8 and C1/H23/F5/latent12 under both portable samplers. Seven isolated compiler dependency files resolved all 25 project dependencies inside the exported sources; no original-checkout numerical dependency or scientific quality finding is claimed.
